name: contact-fieldset
title: Contact fieldset
description: Contact details for a checkout or enquiry: first and last name, email and phone with country code, with autofill tokens and per-field errors.
docs: A fieldset with first and last name side by side (stacked on a phone), email, a phone number with its country code and an optional company line. value (or defaultValue) and onValueChange carry { firstName, lastName, email, phone, company }; the email comes back trimmed and in lower case and the phone number in E.164. A number typed, pasted or filled in with its country code ("+31 6 1234 5678", "0031 6 1234 5678", "+44 7911 123456") picks that country and the field keeps the national number, so it is never stored under the wrong code; the (0) after a code is dropped. A code that is not in the list leaves the value empty and says "Pick the country in the list and leave out the +." when the field is left (unknownCountry in labels). Inputs carry given-name, family-name, email and organization autocomplete tokens with type and inputMode; the phone field's token is tel-national because the country code is its own control. Fields are checked when left, not on every keystroke, and a message goes the moment the problem is fixed. errors adds your own, required lists the required fields, showCompany adds the company line, and disabled switches the whole group off. The phone value that is sent is a hidden input named phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
